invalidated_attachment_preparations.reason: Incorrectly assumed positive CONNECT solref is 2dt-clamped. Actual source integrator is DISCRETE (enum4), which excludes this clamp for equality rows. Wrong negative K=-40000 instead of-250000 weakened reference stiffness6.25x.

notes: CPU float64 re-evaluation uses saved GPU pre-step q/v, not a new dynamics rollout.
Equality force norms are checked for threshold/event/eq consistency, not independently reconstructed without saved efc rows.
Twist axis is the initial attachment-to-fruit COM vector in joint frame; this is a kinematic decomposition, not a calibrated anatomical damage measure.
Spring and damping torque norms do not sum to total norm because they are vectors.
No visual video judgment or target-force/damage inference from whole-scene force maximum.
